proposed_changes.change: Add an author-momentum signal: option_b_required is true when the plan under audit has a prior VETO in the same session's audit history (the auditing agent is judging its own amendment). When codex-plugin and external_reviewer are both absent, define the fresh-context reviewer subagent as the Option B mechanism, so the shortfall has a declared substitute.
proposed_changes.rationale: 3 of 4 VETO findings this session were caught only by an unrequired independent reviewer; the classifier returned false for all four iterations.

proposed_changes.change: Prerequisite phase (own /qor-plan cycle, own branch off main): define governed re-attestation for sealed evidence -- how a boundary-remediated sealed plan and its intent-lock snapshot are re-bound (e.g. a ledger-recorded re-attestation that intent_lock_committed accepts) without editing historical ledger entries or silently rewriting lock records. Then remediate the two known sealed plans and snapshots under it.
proposed_changes.rationale: Obligation 5 and the intent-lock binding currently conflict with no resolution path; the identity-aware seal gate blocks every phase on an overlay host until this lands. Phase 294 resumes after it.

proposed_changes.change: Before a plan edits any sealed artifact, enumerate every verifier that reads its bytes or hash (grep qor/ and tests/ for the path and for the record type storing its hash) and cite each.
proposed_changes.rationale: Iterations 1 and 3 each verified one binding and missed the next (Shadow Genome #33, #35).

proposed_changes.change: Resync installed skill copies to repo source before the next governed cycle.
proposed_changes.rationale: Installed /qor-audit and /qor-substantiate diverge from repo; gates were missed or misnamed.

proposal_text:
Session 2026-09-24T1721-e14f14 audited the Phase 294 plan four times; all four were VETO (ledger #802-#805, Shadow Genome #33-#36) and cycle_count_escalator.check_session_total fired (signature 978ceefca32dc245, cycle_count 3). The event classifier sees only the aggregated codex-plugin capability_shortfall events (4, this session); the VETO streak is visible only in audit history. Both share one root cause and one blocker.

ROOT CAUSE 1 (solo-audit blind spot on self-authored amendments). Each iteration amended a Locked Decision the same agent then judged. audit_risk_score returned option_b_required: false every time. The solo Judge missed three of the four findings (iter 2 specification-drift, iter 3 intent-lock binding, iter 4 fail-closed gate scope); a voluntary fresh-context reviewer subagent found all three. The codex-plugin shortfall events are the same gap: no adversarial reviewer is configured, and the working substitute was an unrequired subagent.

ROOT CAUSE 2 (no governed path to remediate content inside sealed evidence). Two sealed plans on main and their tracked intent-lock plan snapshots carry an outside-repository identity term. doctrine-publication-boundary.md obligation 5 requires remediation; intent_lock_committed (CI, --phase-min 231) binds the Phase 292 plan's bytes to its intent-lock record, so any edit fails CI; the seal-time publication_boundary_lint (substantiate Step 4.6.14) is identity-aware and fail-closed, so every phase sealed on an overlay host now ABORTs. No doctrine or tool defines re-attestation. This blocks Phase 294 (PR #515) and any other phase until resolved.

CONTRIBUTING (install drift). The installed skill copies differ from repo source: the installed /qor-audit omits gate_schema_freeze_lint, plan_enumeration_lint and publication_boundary_lint, which is why the boundary finding surfaced at seal rather than audit, and the installed /qor-substantiate names a gate this repo deliberately lacks (4.6.11).

Events are marked addressed_pending only. The addressed flip requires a PASS /qor-audit with reviews-remediate:<this gate path>, and must not be granted before the Change 1 enforcer exists.
